# Cncf Maven Reviewer

Review Maven using its official documentation and repository in the App Definition and Development / Application Definition &amp; Image Build category. Apache Maven is a software project management and comprehension tool. Based on the concept of a project object model (POM), Maven can manage a project&#39;s build, reporting and documentation from a central piece of information.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
